cohort: 5628 women with one prior low transverse cesarean and a prior vaginal delivery undergoing a trial of labor after cesarean at term
finding: A longer interval since vaginal delivery is associated with a decreased odds of VBAC, but adding this interval to existing VBAC prediction models does not meaningfully improve their predictive ability.
mod_finding: A longer interval since vaginal delivery is associated with a decreased odd of vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC).
